name: KT Spear + Tower Rush into Archer/Horseman Pressure - By Swaggy Professor
author: Swaggy Professor

notes: 4@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to straggler @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Scout heads immediately to opponent base to locate @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or exposed resources
At 150@resource/resource_wood.webp@, build @building_military/barracks.webp@ with 1 food villager
At 200 wood total, build @building_economy/house.webp@ with 1 wood villager
Start training 3@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ with no idle time; force drop food if needed

When 2nd @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ is out, send 1@unit_worker/villager.webp@ with him to build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ near enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or @resource/berrybush.webp@ depending on civ
Once 7 on food, set TC @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
At ~70–80 wood, send 5@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Leave 1 wood villager in @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to maintain house production
At ~4:00, age up with @civilization_flag/hos.webp@
Leave only 3@unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, send rest to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Garrison 1@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ in forward tower, send other 2 to harass
When gold reaches 170, send 5@unit_worker/villager.webp@  from @resource/resource_gold.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Upon Feudal completion, send gold villagers to nearest @resource/boar.webp@ or @resource/deer.webp@
Forward villager builds 2@building_military/archery-range.webp@
Queue 1 @unit_templar/hospitaller_knight_age_2.webp@ and upgrade @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@
Research @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ when mill finishes
Keep producing @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ nonstop from forward @building_military/archery-range.webp@
build @building_military/stable.webp@ at home
Keep 13–15@unit_worker/villager.webp@ on wood, transfer in groups of 5 to new food sources when needed
Use @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ from home stable to surprise opponents expecting only spears/archers
If enemy cavalry raids, produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ from home @building_military/barracks.webp@ to defend
Keep producing units nonstop and build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ for upgrades
Research @technology_templar/safepassage.webp@ later when resources allow, but prioritize unit tempo

description: Early Spear Tower Rush into Archers and Hidden Horsemen Transition
